cases.sentence: Филистимляне воевали с Израилем, и израилетяне бежали от них и падали сраженными на горе ___.
cases.translation: The Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled and fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
cases.explain: The preposition на with falling/location takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Филистимляне нагнали Саула и его ___ и убили его сыновей.
cases.translation: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons and killed his sons.
cases.explain: The verb убили (killed) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: The battle went hard against Saul.
cases.explain: Битва is the subject of the verb разгорелась, taking nominative case.

cases.sentence: Саул сказал своему ___ , «Обнажи меч и закали меня».
cases.translation: Saul said to his armor bearer, Draw your sword and run me through.
cases.explain: The verb сказал (said) takes the dative case for the person addressed.

cases.sentence: Но его ___ не решился сделать это, потому что очень испугался.
cases.translation: But his armor bearer would not do it because he was very afraid.
cases.explain: Оруженосец is the subject of не решился, taking nominative case.

cases.sentence: Тогда Саул взял свой собственный ___ и бросился на него.
cases.translation: Then Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
cases.explain: The verb взял (took) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Так погибли Саул, три его сына и ___ , и все его люди погибли в тот же день.
cases.translation: So Saul, his three sons, and his armor bearer died, and all his men that day.
cases.explain: Оруженосец is part of the compound subject of погибли, requiring nominative.

cases.sentence: Они положили его ___ в храме Астарты и повесили его тело на стене Бет-Шиана.
cases.translation: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth and fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.
cases.explain: The verb положили (put) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

reading.ru: Филистимляне воевали с Израилем, и израилетяне бежали от них и падали сраженными на горе Гильбоа.
reading.question: What happened to the Israeli forces?
options: They fled and fell slain on Mount Gilboa
They made peace with the Philistines
reading.correct: They fled and fell slain on Mount Gilboa
reading.explain: The men of Israel fled before the Philistines and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

reading.ru: Филистимляне нагнали Саула и его сыновей и убили его сыновей, Иоаннафана, Авинодава и Малхишуа.
reading.question: Which of Saul sons were killed?
reading.explain: The Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

reading.ru: Саул сказал своему оруженосцу, «Обнажи меч и закали меня, иначе эти необрезанные придут, станут глумиться надо мной и убьют меня».
reading.question: Why did Saul ask his armor bearer to kill him?
options: To avoid the uncircumcised coming to mock and kill him
To sacrifice himself for his people
He wanted to join Samuel in the spirit world
reading.correct: To avoid the uncircumcised coming to mock and kill him
reading.explain: Saul feared the uncircumcised would come, abuse him, and kill him.

reading.ru: Но его оруженосец не решился сделать это, потому что очень испугался. Тогда Саул взял свой собственный меч и бросился на него.
reading.question: What did Saul do when his armor bearer refused?
options: He took his own sword and fell on it
reading.correct: He took his own sword and fell on it
reading.explain: When the armor bearer would not, Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

reading.ru: Когда оруженосец увидел, что Саул мертв, он тоже бросился на свой меч и умер вместе с ним.
reading.question: What did Saul armor bearer do?
options: He also fell on his own sword and died with Saul
reading.correct: He also fell on his own sword and died with Saul
reading.explain: When the armor bearer saw Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died with him.

reading.ru: На следующий день, когда филистимляне пришли грабить мертвых, они нашли Саула и трех его сыновей, павших на горе Гильбоа.
reading.question: What did the Philistines find the next day?
options: Saul and his three sons lying on Mount Gilboa
A new army arriving from Israel
reading.correct: Saul and his three sons lying on Mount Gilboa
reading.explain: The Philistines found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
